guards: The METHOD transfers: canonical binding, guarded projection, invalidation, two-surface parity, reverse trace, and dogfood accounting may be reused; linguistic conclusions never transfer.

The twelve stages are canonical graph, P V N appearances, morpheme registration, guarded Ṣarf and Naḥw projectors, rival preservation, revocation propagation, rich-at-rest compilation, rich-hover compilation, appearance parity, reverse traces, flywheel uptake, and candidate payload generation.
The loc-surface index and manifest are canonical written-surface authority for this packet; recompute their raw-byte digest and reject mismatch.

Each producer is consumed as an exact packet-schema-artifact-metadata dependency. Every metadata sidecar must bind its own artifact and schema plus upstream artifacts and the loc-surface index and manifest.

The accepted-edge dependency is qamus/task-packets/TP-LARGELEXICON-A3-ACCEPTED-EDGE-OWNER-APPLICATION-W1.json with accepted-edges.jsonl and accepted-edges.meta.json under qamus/examples/largelexicon-a3-accepted-edge-owner-application-w1/. tools/build_typed_edge_crosswalk.py and literal qamus.graph_edge.v1 govern row vocabulary; no invented typed-edge schema is named.
Missing accepted-edge owner application does not block A4 workflow implementation, but it forces LargeLexicon runtime uptake to BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY and zero.

The finalized website fields are appearance.displayed_surface, appearance.canonical_to_appearance_span_map, appearance.binding_state, top-level appearance_binding_hash, and projection.public_projection_eligible.
Every span-map row is closed over segment_index, morpheme_occurrence_id, canonical_char_start, canonical_char_end, appearance_char_start, and appearance_char_end.

appearance_binding_hash is SHA-256 of compact sorted UTF-8 JSON over occurrence_id, artifact_id, projection_hash, appearance_id, page_id, page_kind, binding_state, normalization fixed to NFC, displayed_surface, and canonical_to_appearance_span_map; appearance.page_local is excluded.

The supported quran:61:5:4 primary geometry is canonical 0:2 with mocc:p007:61:5:4 and canonical 2:11 with null morpheme identity. Three shorter appearances map these spans to 0:2 and 2:10. The boundary at 8 and stem or pronoun identities remain candidate alternatives until exact producer evidence supports them.

qamus.pvn_appearance_disposition.v1 is closed and oneOf payload_envelope or ineligible. The payload branch binds exact payload path and hash, projection hash, appearance-binding hash, binding state, displayed surface, span map, and source-row hash. The ineligible branch has nonempty blockers, no payload path or hash, and retains exact appearance identity and displayed surface.

Metadata proves canonical_occurrences 50041, displayed_word_appearances 109471, aligned_appearances 109018, unaligned_appearances 453, payload plus ineligible equals 109471, aligned payload plus aligned ineligible equals 109018, unaligned payload zero, unaligned ineligible 453, and summed occurrence appearance counts 109018.

Each private Claude record binds argv, requested model, actual model, model ID, CLI version, session ID, start SHA, branch, worktree, permitted files, other-reviewer access, raw-stream path and hash, init-record hash, prompt path and hash, output hash, and final commit. Validation parses and reconciles the first raw system/init event.
No page-local analysis, global surface gloss, root-to-entry inference, candidate-to-certified promotion, source prose, website implementation, or live mutation is permitted.
tools/check_regressions.py and docs/golden-commands.md are read-only in this packet. Only TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1 may edit them after final A4 implementation and review.
A4 does not depend on TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1 or any vertical-slice or owner-certification output, preserving the acyclic execution graph.
